summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a 6-K detailing the August 27, 2026 sale of its 70% stake in Talicia Holdings Inc. to an Apotex Health Corp. subsidiary for $18.0 million upfront cash plus up to $35.0 million in worldwide net-sales milestone payments, alongside a transition services agreement. On August 28, 2026, RedHill also paid $12 million upfront to Ferring Pharmaceuticals for exclusive global Rebyota and U.S. Clenpiq rights, with tiered royalties and contingent milestones. Pro forma stockholders' equity exceeds $5 million as of September 30, 2026, curing potential Nasdaq deficiency. Watch milestone realization, royalty economics and equity-covenant sustainability.
